row.body: The key packet includes a water bottle tag from the field crew; the property note asks the new owner not to use the garden tap yet.
row.title: The ideally placed home

sidecar.gloss: A home handover comes with a temporary garden-water restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: A containment inspection could restrict a tap during cleanup; the note does not identify the water concern.

row.body: the packet of tissues and first-aid kit were wiped on one face and left dusty on the other. field twine and warning tape cross at the handle.
row.title: two traces on the packet of tissues

sidecar.gloss: Farm residue and response markings share one deliberately ambiguous bundle.
sidecar.rival_reading: The farm program and the emergency response each explain one layer of the bundle, and the shared knot does not establish which purpose came first.
